prose.passage: The kaleidoscope also matters as a *teaching instrument*. You can build one. This is critical in the context of the Four Pillars: the tool that demonstrates the philosophy is itself a tool you can make and modify. The Max/MSP patch that generates the visual identity — the Lissajous pattern in a sphere — is a kaleidoscope of sorts.
